identity.fantasy: A Shadowflame caster whose critical strikes create more burns, refunds, and Inner Demon pressure until the rotation becomes a self-feeding inferno.
identity.one_line: A Shadowflame caster whose critical strikes create more burns, refunds, and Inner Demon pressure until the rotation becomes a self-feeding inferno. The defining decision is contextual: Proc availability and Felfury pressure change spender timing.

mechanics.core_loop: A Shadowflame caster built around Fel Fireball, Felstrikes, Ruin, critical strikes, and Inner Demon. Crits feed more damage-over-time effects and resource refunds, so the tree scales sharply when its feedback loop is running; missed procs or poor Felfury control make it feel much weaker.

mechanics.single_target: Use Fel Fireball and Felstrikes to feed the crit-dependent Ruin and Inner Demon engine, then spend Felfury without starving refunds. The captured hybrid build is explicitly unfinished pending gear, so no exact priority is treated as settled.
mechanics.aoe: The leading build is designed for both single target and AoE, but provides no repeatable pack sequence. Current roster discussion calls Infernal approachable without resolving late-level button count or proc tracking.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Ranged play offers normal caster spacing, with less evidence for exceptional movement freedom.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Fel Cannon, Doomsayer, Oppressive Ruin.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Cursed Flames, Felbreak, Fel Infusion, Sargeras Embrace.
